_comment: Minute bars for EVERY stock we hold (Two Auctions a Day, section 7). ONE-minute only: the sole EODHD interval with history to 2004 and documented extended hours; resample downstream. Universe = this file's `stocks` (the 100 research names + TSM/ASML/ARM, pulled first) + the `stocks`/`market` of every file in `universe_configs` (S&P list + data-only watchlist) + `market` (SPY/QQQ); ~519 symbols. Written to data/tickdata as 1m/<SYMBOL>/<YYYY>.parquet, APPEND-ONLY: existing bars always win, only missing timestamps are added, untouched files are never rewritten. 5 credits per 120-day request: a cold symbol is ~70 requests, a warm night 1 request/symbol (~2.6k credits). reserve_credits keeps 25k for the nightly eodhd pod. min_free_gb 5 keeps room for the m1x rebuild (4.5 GB); below it the pod grows the volume grow_step_gb at a time.
_vendor_symbols_comment: Only where EODHD's intraday ticker differs from ours. BF-B has no intraday at EODHD under any spelling (probed 2026-09-15); it is recorded as no vendor data and rechecked weekly.
